source_text: Non adorabis ea neque coles. Aliud fabricare, aliud adorare. Etiam sine sculptili mens potest idolis servire.
pass_a_gloss: Not you-shall-adore them nor worship. One-thing to-fashion, another to-adore. Even without carved-thing mind can to-idols serve.
pass_b_english: [[You shall not bow down to them nor worship them >> Bible:Exodus 20:5]]. Fashioning is one thing; worship another. Even without a statue the mind can serve idols.
